lines.text: A hail of silver bullets slice through the battlefield.
Liliweiss charges forward, smashing through the swarm of Raptures.
Every punch sends them flying, scattering them into pieces.
Ahead, the Raptures are so densely packed that the landscape disappears from view.
Liliweiss lowers her stance and throws a punch, putting her full weight behind it.
The scenery comes back into view as the Raptures that had filled it vanish.
She looks down at her hand.
She can still do more.
With a satisfied smile, she charges forward once again.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Take it easy. People might think you're immortal.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Come on, you know that's hardly true.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Besides, I'm pacing myself, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Well, I guess you'll handle it just fine on your own.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: How's the other side holding up?

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: That's actually why I called.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Go check on Snow White. She's probably gonna space out again.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: On it.
Liliweiss runs, cutting through the Raptures in front of her and arriving at Snow White's combat zone.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Snow White, I'm here.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Oh, y-you're here?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Uh, w-well... three missile pods malfunctioned, so my firepower is—
Snow White holds her position, using every weapon at her disposal to strike in all directions.
Before they have any time to react, the Raptures are blown apart by the relentless barrage of bullets and missiles.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Now this is what you call wiping them out.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: H-huh?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Watch out. Eleven o'clock. They're zeroing in on this position.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Eek!
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
*Boom!*

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Three o'clock!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: O-on it!
*Rat-a-tat*
*Clink clink clink*

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: M-my ammo!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It's okay. Stay calm. Your barrage is more than enough for now. You're safe.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: G-got it!
Snow White tries to reload.
However, her trembling hands fumble the magazine, clanking against the gun's body.
Snow White looks up at Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You've got to do this on your own. You're a Goddess, aren't you?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: O-of course. Yes.
After three failed attempts, she finally manages to reload her weapon. She fires her rounds toward the three o'clock direction.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Nice job!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You've got more than enough firepower—excessively so. It won't matter even if three missile pods malfunctioned.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The Raptures won't even get close to you or attack you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Just keep bombarding them from a safe distance, like you're doing now. You copy?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Y-yes! Copy!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Good. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Yeah!
Liliweiss leaves, breaking into a run.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: She still gets flustered when something unexpected arises.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: That's why she's always the most prepared before an operation. She knows her weaknesses better than anyone.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I know. But she could stand to be a little bolder.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Hah. She's already a walking arsenal. Can you imagine if she gets any bolder?

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: You know, Snow White's kill count just caught up to Dorothy's.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, she's got the makings of something big. I'm looking forward to seeing what she's like in a few years.
Scarlet charges forward, swinging her sword and cleaving the Raptures in two.
Liliweiss runs alongside Scarlet.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Any problems?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: A problem, thou sayest? None at all... Nay!
Without slowing down, Scarlet swings her sword at a heavy armored Rapture.
But the blade lodges deep into its body, unable to cut through.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Tch!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Let me help.
Liliweiss lightly taps the back of Scarlet's sword with her fist.
The blade surges forward, slicing the Rapture neatly in half.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Why do you keep obsessing over severing them in two? You can't even do it properly.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Next time, I shall cleave with greater celerity and might.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Just stab or slash the core.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The core and the surrounding area are... relatively softer.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Thus, such would prove naught of my strength.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: To strike in one swift stroke is the very essence of true swordsmanship.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: My, I didn't know we had a sword master in our squad.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Aim for the weak spots. That's the smartest way to fight.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Hmph. Pay heed.
Scarlet adjusts her stance.
She swings her sword at the advancing heavy armored Rapture.
*Slash*
The Rapture splits in two under the impact of Scarlet's strike.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Said I not? Celerity and might are all that is required.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Hence, I shall not stoop to such dishonorable acts as striking at feeble spots like some craven.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: How amazing!
A heavy armored Rapture lunges at Liliweiss.
She grabs its front leg, twists,
and slams it to the ground.
Then she lifts her foot and lightly stomps on its core.
*Crack*
The Rapture goes silent.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Some have to swing their swords with all their strength to barely take one down, while others manage it with just a simple gesture.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: That's called fighting smart.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Curse thee, Mecha Destructor...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... What did you say?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Begone. Do not dampen the spirits of those who fight with valor.
Scarlet grumbles and charges forward.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Her obsession with head-on clashes and one-stroke finishes... I don't even know what to say.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: She fights well. While she may struggle in large-scale battles, she's nearly unbeatable in one-on-one confrontations.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Put her up against those pesky elite Raptures, and she consistently exceeds expectations.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Nonetheless, she's way too rigid.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: If she just dropped that stubborn streak of hers, she'd be so much better.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Still, she offers excellent cost-efficiency and operational versatility.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Cost-efficiency?

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Look, since she has a mass-produced body, maintenance is easy. Bullets and missiles are not necessary.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Just drop her in, and she clears the field. What more could a commander ask for?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... Would you call someone like that a reliable jack-of-all-trades? What's all this talk about "cost-efficiency" anyway?

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Enough, let's go check on Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Roger.
Liliweiss crouches down to the ground,
then kicks off from the surface, launching herself upward. The entire battlefield unfolds before her eyes.
She spots a golden light flashing in the distance and lands in its direction.
*Thud*

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Lilith.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: How are the mass-produced units doing?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: 32 wounded and zero fatalities so far.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Zero? And only that many wounded? That's incredible.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: They're all doing well. It's no wonder they're the elite.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Wonderful. Can we keep it that way?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Every time I step onto the battlefield, I tell myself

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: that this time, no one will die.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: But I fail every time.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It just might work this time. I have a good feeling.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Yes, I'll do my best.
A mass-produced Nikke rushes over, carrying another whose lower body has been blown apart.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Rapunzel! Rapunzel!

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: We've got a critical casualty!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: This way!

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: She was hit by a beam weapon! About three minutes ago!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: All right! I'll administer first aid!
A golden light radiates from Rapunzel's body.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: First aid's done, but she needs to get to the Repair Center to fully recover.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: She won't die if we leave her like this, but she might experience a Mind Switch.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: What's your name, Sister?

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Pinne! My name's Pinne!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: All right, Sister Pinne. Can you take her to the Repair Center?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: As you know, even the rear defense lines aren't safe from the Raptures either.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Will you be okay?

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: ... I'll try!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Good. I'm counting on you. Tell them to treat her with the B-2 protocol when you get there.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: B-2, B-2... Got it!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Should I go? I'd be much faster.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: It's okay. Just focus on what needs to be done.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Let's end this battle as quickly as possible, even if it's just by a second.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... All right, leave it to me.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_o
lines.text: Go now, both of you.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Copy!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Roger.
Pinne lifts the wounded Nikke on her back and dashes toward the rear, while Liliweiss charges toward the battlefield.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: She's doing great. She knows exactly where everyone should be and what they need to do.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Clear and decisive, without any hesitation.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Rapunzel is essential for holding the front line. Having her out there makes a significant difference.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: If I had to pick the next leader, it'd be her.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: But Rapunzel has a critical weakness.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, she gets overly attached to the deaths of others and shows too much empathy.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: A battlefield where lives are snuffed out like candles is not where she belongs.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: But that's also why she's able to unleash her true potential.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Yes. It's both her strength and her weakness.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: So how do we deal with it?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Well, to be honest, I have no idea when it comes to Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Hmm... Dorothy requested backup.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Dorothy? What's going on?
Liliweiss stops beside Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: What's wrong? It's unusual for you to be calling me.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I want to secure the high ground at ten o'clock, but the path is too dangerous.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Could you clear the way?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Leave it to me.
Liliweiss steps forward and throws a punch, putting her full weight behind it.
A thunderous metallic crash echoes, clearing the path ahead.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: There. Done.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: What else do you need?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That will do. You can go now.
Dorothy sprints ahead, gaining the high ground, and then engages the Raptures with impressive acrobatic precision.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: She sure knows how to get people to work to her advantage.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: She'll make a great leader. After all, a great leader knows how to use people well.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: True. That's why Dorothy is the best fit for now.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: The east side's getting pushed back.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Let's take care of it.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Copy.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: Take a break if it gets too rough.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Can I, though? When the girls are out there fighting with all their hearts?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: As a leader, I've got to set an example.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: All right, then. Go, Mecha Destructor.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'll just head that way.

lines.speaker: commander_op_r
lines.text: I was just kidding. No need to take it so seriously.
